% E2E canonical fixture — variable-size delimiters and
% large operators (cascade #4).
%
% Exercises the two constructs that alter the math glyph stream:
%   * a tall \left( ... \over ... \right) around a fraction — rule-19
%     delimiter sizing (TeX:The Program §762): the parens grow to span the
%     two-line fraction (var_delimiter §706-710, §B).
%   * a display $$\sum_{i=1}^{n}$$ — large-operator size switch (the display
%     \sum successor glyph) with limits set above/below (make_op §749-750,
%     App G rule 13, §E).
%
% The glyph stream + positions byte-compare to MiKTeX-pdfTeX 4.19 (ground
% truth) within the tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H), via the
% shared DVI-walker harness in tests/test_e2e_dvi_baseline.py (AC-7).
%
% NOTE on \big-family: AC-2 (\bigl/\Bigl growth via the real plain.tex
% \big macros) is DEFERRED to — those macros expand to a nested
% \hbox{$\left(\vbox..\right.$} the math-field scanner cannot execute, so a
% \bigl( would NOT byte-match MiKTeX here.  This fixture therefore proves the
% delivered \left/\right rule-19 + large-op leg only; the \bigl( fixed-size
% check rides on.
%
% Under the bundled plain.tex format the math families (\textfont0..3), the
% \over macro, \left/\right, and the \sum \mathop (with \limits default in
% display) are all set up.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
The sized fraction $\left(a+b\over c+d\right)$ spans two lines.
\par
$$\sum_{i=1}^{n}$$
\bye
